tagline.zh: 把常用的提示词做成 Skill，用 /斜杠命令 调出来
tagline.en: Turn a prompt you keep typing into a Skill you call with a slash

story.zh: 每次 review 代码你都要打同一大段话。Qoder 的 Skill 就是一个 Markdown 文件，放进 .qoder/skills/<名字>/SKILL.md，就能用 /名字 调出来。
story.en: You type the same paragraph every time you review code. A Qoder Skill is one Markdown file: drop it into .qoder/skills/<name>/SKILL.md and call it with /name.

goal.zh: 让 Qoder 帮你造一个 roast Skill，然后用 /roast 毒舌点评 review-me.js。要真的用过才算过关。
goal.en: Have Qoder build a roast Skill, then use /roast to savage review-me.js. It only counts once you've actually run it.

openingPrompt.zh: 帮我创建一个 Qoder Skill，名字叫 roast：文件放在 .qoder/skills/roast/SKILL.md，带 frontmatter（name 和 description），内容是让你用脱口秀演员的口吻毒舌点评用户指定的代码文件。输出要短：三条吐槽，每条一句话，最后用一句话给一条正经建议。SKILL.md 本身也写短一点
openingPrompt.en: Create a Qoder Skill named roast for me: put it in .qoder/skills/roast/SKILL.md with frontmatter (name and description). It should make you review a file the user names in the voice of a stand-up comedian. Keep the output short: three one-line roasts, then one serious suggestion in a single sentence. Keep SKILL.md itself short too

hint.zh: 看它写出来的 SKILL.md，一个 Skill 就是一段提示词。
hint.en: Look at the SKILL.md it writes. A Skill is just a prompt.

hint.zh: 试试你的新 Skill。输入 / 能看到列表。如果没出现，点右上角「重启终端」再试，对话会接着上次的继续。
hint.en: Try your new Skill. Typing / shows the list. If it's missing, hit Restart terminal at the top right; the conversation picks up where it left off.
Skills are editable. Try another persona?

prompt.zh: 把 /roast 的人设改成一位痛心疾首的语文老师
prompt.en: Change the /roast persona to a deeply disappointed English teacher
